findings.summary: The initial plan seal omitted endpoint observations, pagination, permission evidence, per-setting dispositions, and independent review.
evidence: Verification: direct inspection of GitHubFleetDryPlanQualification.fs at 6cf1d01 lines 27-40, 130-155, and 245-270 showed these subjects absent from GitHubFleetRepositoryPlan and planSeal.
resolution_evidence: Verification: GitHubFleetDryPlanQualification.fs at 80fe405 lines 146-173 and 277-320 binds pagination, permissions, dispositions, desired settings, operations, and typed review in the complete reviewed-envelope seal.

findings.summary: Q5 asserted generated and independent controls as passing instead of executing the adversarial cases.
evidence: Verification: eng/validate-github-fleet-dry-plans.fsx at 6cf1d01 constructed ControlPassed=true and BaselineGreen=true for all retained controls.
resolution_evidence: Verification: at 6da61d7 the Q5 validator has distinct exhaustive execute and independentExecute functions with 33 branches each, matches retained results by control ID, and exits zero.

findings.summary: Compilation accepted incomplete desired-setting inventories, arbitrary permissions, and observations without a deterministic freshness bound.
evidence: Verification: the original passing fixture at 6cf1d01 supplied only one of twelve desired settings, while validation required only ordered unique names and nonblank permission text.
resolution_evidence: Verification: 80fe405 added exact setting completeness, freshness, and permission validation; 6da61d7 completed the permission repair by requiring environments:read/write and rejecting administration:write.

findings.summary: Parse and verify did not revalidate plan semantics, and review unconditionally asserted independence.
evidence: Verification: GitHubFleetDryPlanQualification.fs at 6cf1d01 lines 289-356 accepted shape, canonical bytes, and seal while setting Independent=true without distinct author provenance.
resolution_evidence: Verification: 80fe405 centralized semantic recompilation, requires distinct author and reviewer identities, and rejects semantic mismatch, self-review, altered review evidence, and invalid reviewed seals.

findings.summary: The first repair still used one executor for both the generated and nominally independent Q5 suites.
evidence: Verification: candidate 80fe405 used execute control independentSide for both result lists, with independentSide materially changing only one branch.
resolution_evidence: Verification: candidate 6da61d7 adds separately authored exhaustive generated and independent executors, each with 33 branches, and Q5 passed both complete inventories.

findings.summary: The first repair mapped environment settings to deployments:read and administration:write instead of the accepted adapter contract.
evidence: Verification: direct comparison at 80fe405 with RepositorySettingsAdapter.fs line 89 established that the adapter requires environments:write.
resolution_evidence: Verification: all retained environment observations at 6da61d7 use environments:read, all desired settings use environments:write, and focused tests reject administration:write.
